v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, * et nubes pluant iustum: aperiátur terra, et gérminet Salvatórem.
text.en: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, * and let the skies pour down the Righteous One: let the earth open and bring forth the Saviour.

text.la: Emítte Agnum, Dómine, * Dominatórem terræ, de Petra desérti, ad montem fíliæ Sion.
text.en: Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, * the Ruler of the land, from the rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

text.la: Ut cognoscámus, Dómine, * in terra viam tuam, in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
text.en: That thy way, O Lord, * may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

text.la: Da mercédem, Dómine, * sustinéntibus te, ut prophétæ tui fidéles inveniántur.
text.en: O Lord, * reward them that wait for thee, and let thy prophets be found faithful.

text.la: Lex per Móysen data est, * grátia et véritas per Iesum Christum facta est.
text.en: The law was given by Moses, * but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Tu Béthlehem * terra Iuda, non eris mínima: ex te enim éxiet Dux, qui regat pópulum meum Israël.
text.en: Thou, Bethlehem, * in the land of Judah, shalt not be the least (among the princes of Judah) for out of thee shall come a Ruler, That shall rule my people Israel.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.

office.title: Feria III infra Hebd III Adventus
